g.text: Card lifecycle — a finite state machine (FSRS-6)
Scheduling structures — chosen by hot-path cost

div.p: Two levers carry most designs: (1) model state as an explicit FSM so transitions are total and testable; (2) pick structures by the cost of the operation you do most. Reviews constantly pop the soonest-due card → a min-heap (O(log n)) beats re-sorting a list (O(n log n)). Reading fires seam checks every scroll frame → an O(1) IntersectionObserver beats an O(n) scroll handler.

text.tspan: Due queue = min-heap keyed by due-date
push O(log n) · pop-min O(log n) · peek O(1)
vs naive scroll listener O(n) per scroll
